Senior AI Agent Engineer focused on productionizing AI-driven agent workflows, retrieval-augmented systems, and customer-facing conversational features. Notice period: 60 days.

Senior AI Agent Engineer, Nykaa — Aug 2021 - Present
Built and deployed multi-turn commerce agents that automated customer support and order lifecycle tasks. Led implementation of retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using product catalogs and support KBs, improving response relevance and deflection rates. Developed agent orchestration and step-by-step action planning that integrated third-party services and internal APIs. Implemented LangChain-based chains for context management and prompt templating, and created Next.js front-end components to expose conversational widgets embedded in web checkout and account pages. Introduced CI workflows and Git-based release practices for models and agent code. Worked in Agile sprints and maintained Linux-based inference hosts for low-latency serving.

Founding Engineer, Razorpay — Oct 2020 - Jul 2021
Contributed to early-stage AI features for payments and merchant onboarding, focusing on automating KYC flows and merchant support using AI Agents. Prototyped Large Language Models integrations for structured data extraction and dispute summarization, producing parsers and validation pipelines in Python and TypeScript. Built retrieval layers (RAG) over transactional and helpdesk data to surface context for model responses. Implemented end-to-end pipelines, model evaluation, and deployment scripts on Linux servers, and managed code with Git. Participated in Agile planning, collaborated with product and infra teams to iterate quickly.

Skills:
Python, Large Language Models, AI Agents, TypeScript, RAG, LangChain, Next.js, Git, Agile, Linux
